title: Managing Director – Implementation Center of Excellence (iCoE)_PMO
description:
**Role Purpose**


The MD for the Implementation Center of Excellence (iCoE) is accountable for establishing, scaling, and governing State Street’s high ‑ capability PMO function for client implementation across various workstreams in STT Alpha. The MD ensures that the iCoE becomes a **strategic capability** , reducing vendor dependency, improving cost efficiency, strengthening internal expertise, and enabling predictable client delivery at scale.  



**Key Responsibilities**


**iCoE Strategy, Design \& Build** ‑ **Out**


* Lead the end ‑ to ‑ end design and multi ‑ year implementation of the iCoE operating model, including functional scope, hiring strategy, location footprint, and resource mix.
  

Transition execution ‑ heavy work from high ‑ cost vendors into the iCoE through structured knowledge transfer, scaling internal capability, and reducing dependence on vendors
* A ligning contractor ‑ to ‑ FTE transitions and phasing resource migration strategically.
  

Drive FTE vs Contractor ratio strategy, establishing a sustainable talent supply model for PMO, and other iCoEs as required
**PMO** **CoE**

* The MD will oversee and build leadership capability across PMO functions – STT End to end implementation planning , Risk management, Reporting , Tools \& Automation / Ai initiatives
* Strengthen the focus on executing the PMO iCoE strategy, including contractor reduction, capability build\-out, location strategy and cost optimization
* A ccountable for the global strategy, delivery excellence, operating model, and financial performance of enterprise PMO services supporting large ‑ scale client implementations and platform transformations.
* Champion **AI** ‑ **enabled** **Program governance** **, intelligent** **data driven** **analytics, and** **risk** **management** capabilities
* Establish Standard governance, cadence, reporting standards, milestone planning, and dependencies management.
* Drive collaboration and partnerships with other CoEs and Alpha implementation teams to deliver client implementation programs successfully
* Stand up a unified India ‑ based PMO function with SMEs, leads, and analyst teams.
* Establish integrated support model with Conversion , Business Integration / Target Operating Model (TOM) Alignment , Environment Management, Alpha Data Services, Governance \& Vendor Relations .
* Ensure consistent delivery across **front, middle, and back** ‑ **office** **End to end** **implementations** , complex data flows, and integrations.
* Enable OBM (Outcome ‑ Based Model) transition by linking partner payments to outcomes and making sure that sub\-outcomes are delivered in a timely manner with expected quality
**People Leadership \& Capability Development**


* Build and lead a **leadership team** (VP/AVP layers) across PMO teams .
* Establish senior leadership layers within iCoE
* Manage onboarding of new hires , training, knowledge transfer and creation of standard PMO playbooks, frameworks and best practices.
* Drive capability building across CoEs , ensuring consistent training and best ‑ practice adoption.
* Foster a culture of **accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence** .
* Accountable for building a sustainable operating model, workforce planning, succession planning and long\-term hub growth.
* Establish **career paths, competency frameworks, and succession plans** for testing professionals.
* Lead capability build ‑ out in **India and other strategic hubs** , including CoE scale ‑ up and leadership bench strength.
* **Engage globally** and drive PMO strategy
**Governance, Reporting \& Stakeholder Engagement**


* Create and operate iCoE governance structures across program reporting (client implementations) , risk management, productivity metrics, and leadership oversight.
* Represent iCoE progress to senior leadership and participate in recurring strategic governance meetings.
* Provide **clear executive** ‑ **level reporting** on quality, risks, dependencies, and decision points.
* Ensure alignment with the broader GCI and Alpha three ‑ year strategy, including OBM rollout and partner consolidation.
**Operational Efficiency, Productivity \& Financial Management**


* Achieve targeted cost reductions by shifting work from high ‑ cost locations to the India hub.
  

Improve FTE ‑ to ‑ contractor and HCL ‑ to ‑ Hub ratios, driving labor arbitrage benefits and operational scalability.
* Responsible for process simplification, automation, digitalization and AI adoption to improve productivity and scalability.
* Drive automation, standardization, tool adoption, reporting quality, and process enhancement.
  

Track financials, onboarding flows, hiring dependencies, and realization of O utcome based milestone payments
* A ccountability for tracking and delivering business benefits/ outcomes, including contractor reduction, productivity improvements and cost savings.
* Engage with vendor partners to manage consultants and deliver quality results
* Support sales and pre ‑ sales activities through estimation models, proposals, and client solution shaping
**Required Skills \& Experience**


**Experience**


* 15 \+ years in large ‑ scale implementation, transformation, PMO leadership in client implementation programs (global model) , or delivery operations in financial services.
* Proven success managing global delivery hubs or Centers of Excellence at scale.
* Demonstrated experience transitioning vendor work in ‑ house and managing hybrid workforce models.
* Proven track record leading **global, complex, client** ‑ **facing transformation programmes** .
* Deep understanding of **financial services platforms** , data ‑ heavy architectures, and regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ownership of **P\&L, operating models, and large global team**
**Leadership \& Execution**


* Exceptional ability to build and lead multi ‑ disciplinary teams across Testing, PMO, Conversion, Product, Data, and Ops.
* Strong stakeholder influence across MD/SVP levels in Operations, Technology, and Client organizations.
**Technical \& Functional Acumen**


* Solid understanding of Front office, middle office and Back office components, implementation workflows, PMO tools and data migration models.
**Governance \& Change Management**


* Deep knowledge of PMO governance, risk management, performance metrics, and delivery controls.
**About State Street**  



**What we do.** State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data \& analytics, investment research \& trading and investment management to institutional clients.  



**Work, Live and Grow.** We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary in locations, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.  



**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.** We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspective are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome the candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift program and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.


State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.
